# UIFlexItem

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIFlexItem")`

Sets how its parent behaves as a child of a `UIListLayout`. It controls whether the parent grows into leftover space, whether it shrinks when the line is too long, and where it sits across the line. Parent it to the object it affects.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FlexMode` | `Enum.UIFlexMode` | `Enum.UIFlexMode.None` | read/write | Whether the object grows, shrinks, or both. |
| `GrowRatio` | `number` | `1` | read/write | When `FlexMode` is `Custom`: the object's share of the leftover space, relative to the other children that grow. An object at 2 next to one at 1 takes two thirds. |
| `ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Automatic` | read/write | The position of the object across its line. `Automatic` uses the layout's `ItemLineAlignment`. |
| `ShrinkRatio` | `number` | `1` | read/write | When `FlexMode` is `Custom`: the object's share of the space the line is short by, relative to the other children that shrink. |
